name: plc_capabilities_list
description: List planned PLC engineering capabilities and their verification status. Production blocks unverified capabilities. The separate validation host can execute explicitly allowlisted operations as unverified.

name: plc_device_add
description: Add or plug a device under an explicit parent using exact type/id/version/module. Device packages must already exist in the IDE.

name: plc_device_get_io_mappings
description: Enumerate mappable IO variables with stable connector/parameter/element addresses. Not EtherCAT PDO configuration.

name: plc_device_get_parameters
description: Enumerate offline device/connector parameters and nested element addresses, types, access rights and values; truncation is explicit.

name: plc_device_get_tree
description: Read device identities, module IDs and parent relationships. No online connection.

name: plc_device_remove
description: Remove a device in a candidate; explicitly acknowledge nonempty subtrees. The template controller and application roots are protected.

name: plc_device_set_io_mapping
description: Map one channel to a qualified existing variable, explicitly create an unqualified variable, or clear with an empty expression. Read back creation/existing mapping flags.

name: plc_device_set_parameter
description: Write one primitive offline parameter by device GUID and structural address. Check declared type, range/enum and offline access; never call online write APIs.

name: plc_dut_create
description: Create a Structure/Enumeration/Alias/Union DUT with a complete TYPE declaration. Alias requires baseType; array aliases can use an ARRAY type expression.

name: plc_dut_read
description: Read a DUT declaration by GUID from an explicit project version. No implementation text or graphical network is synthesized.

name: plc_dut_update
description: Replace a DUT declaration by GUID and verify persistence after reopening the candidate.

name: plc_exchange_read
description: Read an exchange artifact in bounded chunks; offsets are UTF-16 code units. Use returned nextOffset. Hash verification occurs on every read.

name: plc_exchange_stage
description: Stage bounded UTF-8 XML as an immutable artifact. Format is plcopen or codesys-native. Reject DTD/entities. Structure checks are not IDE validation or compilation.

name: plc_exchange_validate
description: Inspect format, POU names, languages, extensions and structural limits. This is not full XSD validation, dependency resolution or compilation.

name: plc_folder_create
description: Create a folder under a known object or project root. Return its actual GUID after creation.

name: plc_graph_decode
description: Decode exactly one graph-v1 POU from an artifact. Refuse unrepresented extensions or program data; the original artifact remains available.

name: plc_graph_generate
description: Generate original PLCopen TC6 XML from graph-v1 LD/FBD/basic-SFC nodes, variables, named block pins and connections. Return an artifact and semantic hash. Does not run an IDE or PLC compiler.

name: plc_gvl_create
description: Create a GVL with a complete VAR_GLOBAL declaration in a managed version; read back after save and reopen.

name: plc_gvl_read
description: Read a GVL declaration by GUID from an explicit project version. Returns a file revision; use plc_workspace_get for the managed editing revision.

name: plc_gvl_update
description: Replace a GVL declaration by GUID, preserving earlier immutable versions.

name: plc_job_cancel
description: Request cancellation. CancelRequested does not confirm executor termination; terminal jobs retain their existing outcome.

name: plc_job_get
description: Read a durable job state. A successful status query does not mean the engineering operation succeeded.

name: plc_job_get_result
description: Read a terminal result. Pending, failed, cancelled and unknown outcomes return isError=true, preserving available compile diagnostics.

name: plc_job_reconcile
description: Reconcile an unknown edit only from durable stopped-executor evidence and matching files. Does not rerun scripts, overwrite files or force-unlock an unproven outcome.

name: plc_library_add
description: Add a reference to one exact installed library display name. Fail when missing or ambiguous.

name: plc_library_list
description: Read references and placeholder resolution from an existing library manager. Does not create a manager during a read.

name: plc_library_list_installed
description: Query the IDE library repository. Exact display names include version/company. Does not install or uninstall libraries.

name: plc_library_remove
description: Remove an explicit project library reference by exact name; system references are protected.

name: plc_library_set_placeholder
description: Create/update a placeholder with explicit default resolution and/or redirection. Null leaves a setting unchanged; empty redirection clears it. Return effective resolution separately.

name: plc_object_delete
description: Delete an object in a candidate. Nonempty subtree requires recursive=true; protected roots and known task dependencies are rejected.

name: plc_object_inspect
description: Inspect a node, children and known task-call impacts. Use project for the root. This is not a compiler reference analysis.

name: plc_object_move
description: Move an object to a permitted parent with optional child index (-1 appends). Reject cycles, name collisions and known call dependencies.

name: plc_object_rename
description: Rename a non-system object after checking its current name and task-call references. Does not promise global source refactoring.

name: plc_pou_create
description: Create Program/FunctionBlock/Function under a parent GUID, save and reopen a new workspace version. ST/IL accept text; LD/FBD/SFC/CFC creation leaves graphical content empty. Function needs returnType; SFC Function is invalid.

name: plc_pou_graph_read
description: Read graph-v1 LD/FBD/basic-SFC content from an actual POU via PLCopen export. Return nodes, variables and semantic hash. Unsupported extensions are explicit errors; use project export for opaque exchange.

name: plc_pou_graph_write
description: Create or replace a complete graph-v1 POU from an artifact in a managed candidate. Updating requires objectId and expectedGraphSha256 from graph read. Name/type/language cannot change; unknown properties cannot be discarded. Readback verifies logic before publication.

name: plc_pou_member_create
description: Create Method/Property/Action under an eligible parent. Property bodies are getter/setter sources. Null source leaves generated content unchanged; graph languages create empty content.

name: plc_pou_member_read
description: Read Method/Property/Action source by GUID, including Property Get/Set children. Kind selects the expected member shape.

name: plc_pou_member_update
description: Update member source by GUID and expected kind; save/reopen/readback the member and property accessors. Does not change its language or return type.

name: plc_pou_read
description: Queue reading a textual object's declaration and implementation by GUID. Graphical networks are not represented as source strings.

name: plc_pou_update
description: Replace explicit declaration and/or textual implementation by GUID in an isolated candidate. Null leaves that part unchanged. Save/readback/reopen must succeed before publishing the new revision. Graphical networks cannot be replaced with text.

name: plc_project_compile
description: Queue compilation of an explicit Application GUID. Acceptance is not compilation success. Fixture diagnostics are simulated.

name: plc_project_create
description: Create a managed workspace from a registered template or registered existing-project copy. Verify/save/reopen in a candidate; never overwrite the source. Fixture files are simulated.

name: plc_project_export
description: Export selected GUIDs, subtrees or [project] through the official IDE API. Format plcopen or codesys-native. Results include an artifact, exact selection and reporter messages; no arbitrary output paths.

name: plc_project_get_structure
description: Queue a bounded project-tree read; poll its result. No project content is changed; a task record is created.

name: plc_project_import
description: Import a staged artifact into a managed candidate at a parent GUID or project. Conflict policy reject/replace/skip is explicit. Save/reopen/re-export proof precedes publication. Unknown/partial failures never publish; warnings require allowWarnings.

name: plc_project_open
description: Submit a project-open check. Each operation owns and closes its session; this does not keep a GUI project open. Fixture mode is simulated.

name: plc_project_save
description: Finalize a new delivery snapshot: save and reopen a copy of the current managed version. Earlier edits already persist to working versions. Delivery does not imply compilation, task binding or PLC runtime correctness.

name: plc_runtime_get_status
description: Report execution mode and scheduler state. Fixture results are simulated; real InoProShop capabilities are not yet verified.

name: plc_task_configuration_create
description: Create the Task Configuration under an Application if absent; no PLC online action.

name: plc_task_create
description: Create a task under an existing Task Configuration, with explicit kind, units, priority and watchdog.

name: plc_task_delete
description: Remove a task from a candidate version after checking its current name. Older versions remain available.

name: plc_task_list
description: Read task configurations and tasks under an explicit Application. Preserve call order and units.

name: plc_task_read
description: Read one task with its settings and ordered program calls.

name: plc_task_set_calls
description: Replace the complete ordered task call list. Empty array unbinds all. Each call supplies the Program GUID, name and comment; rejects ambiguous names and non-Program POUs.

name: plc_task_update
description: Replace task scheduling settings. Omitted watchdog/core binding remain unchanged; kind-specific fields must be valid.

name: plc_templates_list
description: List registered templates and declared-file revisions. IDE profile, controller and libraries are declared requirements, not verified installed dependencies.

name: plc_workspace_get
description: Get the managed workspace's current manifest revision and immutable project path. Use this revision for editing; file-read revisions are a separate scope.
